verdict.rationale: Radar supports lists, including a trusted-customer allow list, that rules can reference. Value lists are exposed programmatically via the API, and custom rules can be built in the Dashboard. A community report says allow rules are not enabled by default for newer businesses and must be turned on through support. Missing for 10: evidence of velocity-limit rules, explicit list types for emails, cards, devices and IPs, self-serve allow rules without contacting support, and independent hands-on confirmation of list management through both the Dashboard and the API.
